  ## Auto-Download

  **Models auto-download on first run** - no manual setup needed!

  | Model | VRAM | Download Size |
  |-------|------|---------------|
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-bf16 (recommended) | ~12GB | ~7GB |
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-fp8 | ~8-12GB | ~4GB |
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B (fp32) | ~20GB | ~14GB |

  | File | Size | Link |
  |------|------|------|
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-bf16 | ~7GB | [Download](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-bf16) |
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-fp8 | ~4GB | [Download](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-fp8) |
  | LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B (fp32) | ~14GB | [Download](https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B) |

  Place in `ComfyUI/models/audiodit/` as folder names: `LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-bf16`, `LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-fp8`, or `LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B`

  ---

  ## FP8 model is dequantized to BF16 at load time using per-tensor scales from fp8_scales.json

  ---

  ## Nodes

  | Node | Description |
  |------|-------------|
  | **LongCat AudioDiT TTS** | Basic text-to-speech synthesis |
  | **LongCat AudioDiT Voice Clone TTS** | Clone voice from 3-15s reference audio |
  | **LongCat AudioDiT Multi-Speaker TTS** | Multi-speaker dialogue with [speaker_N]: tags |

  ---

  ## Parameters

  | Parameter | Default | Description |
  |-----------|---------|-------------|
  | steps | 16 | ODE Euler solver steps (4-64) |
  | guidance_strength | 4.0 | CFG/APG guidance scale (0-10) |
  | guidance_method | cfg / apg | cfg for TTS, apg for voice cloning |
  | dtype | auto | auto, bf16, fp16, fp32 |
  | attention | auto | auto, sdpa, sage_attention, flash_attention |
  | keep_model_loaded | true | Cache model + auto-offload to CPU between runs |

  ---

  ## Voice Cloning

  Connect reference audio (3-15 seconds recommended) to `prompt_audio` input. Providing `prompt_text` (transcript) improves quality significantly.

  ---

  ## Multi-Speaker

  Use `[speaker_N]:` tags in text:
  [speaker_1]: Hello, welcome to the show!
  [speaker_2]: Thanks for having me!
  [speaker_1]: Let's get started.

  ---

  - Original [LongCat-AudioDiT](https://github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT)
  - Models [3.5B](https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B) / [3.5B-bf16](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-bf16) / [3.5B-fp8](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/LongCat-AudioDiT-3.5B-fp8)
